comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, MAJOR): pin the SKILL.md Step 1 wiring contract. (1) STDOUT: migration-class-detect.sh emits exactly one JSON line; when sg is unavailable or no symbol is determinable it emits migration-class=inconclusive — in that case STILL write the marker (do not skip it; 'never silently false'). (2) CLI FORM (mirror COMPLEXITY_CLASSIFICATION): write via '.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <story-id> "MIGRATION_CLASS: {json}"', unconditional and non-interactive. (3) IDEMPOTENCY/LAST-WINS: re-running Step 1 appends a second MIGRATION_CLASS comment; consumers MUST read the LAST matching comment (mirror the PREPLANNING_CONTEXT 'scan for the last comment' idiom). State this in the SKILL.md instruction so it agrees with the contract doc (task-2).
